title: The 4 Best Garden Hoses for Hot Climates
h1: The 4 Best Garden Hoses for Hot Climates
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for garden hoses for hot climates, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at garden hoses for hot climates using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Flexzilla Garden Hose 5/8 in. x 50 ft.
products.blurb: Key specs: Hybrid polymer construction, Usable from about minus 40°F to 150°F, Zero memory, resists heat-set stiffening.
strengths: Wide minus 40°F to 150°F range covers both peak summer heat and cooler desert nights without stiffening
Zero memory construction resists the permanent heat-set curling that happens to vinyl hoses left coiled in the sun
Anodized aluminum fittings do not corrode the way some coated metal fittings do under constant UV
limitations: Dark colored hoses, including Flexzilla's, absorb more heat than light colored hoses
Fittings can loosen over years of thermal expansion and contraction
No dedicated UV-blocking coating beyond the base material

products.name: Craftsman Heavy Duty Professional Grade Garden Hose 50 ft.
products.blurb: Key specs: POLYFUSION hybrid construction, Crush-resistant anodized aluminum couplings, 5/8-inch diameter, 50-foot length.
strengths: Thicker walled construction holds up to years of full sun exposure on a patio or driveway without splitting
Crush-resistant couplings resist warping from being stepped on when hot and softened
Bi-material grips stay comfortable to handle even when the hose body is hot to the touch
limitations: Heavier than hybrid polymer options, more noticeable in high heat when handling for long stretches
Higher price than a basic vinyl hose
Less flexible in cold weather than in warm weather
features: Rated for consistent flexibility in heat

products.name: Teknor Apex NeverKink 8615-50 Garden Hose 5/8 in. x 50 ft.
products.blurb: Key specs: Dual-layer reinforced sheathing, Corkscrew-resistant construction, 5/8-inch diameter, 50-foot length.
strengths: Reinforced sheathing helps the hose resist the softening-then-kinking cycle that happens on hot pavement
Lifetime warranty gives genuine long-term coverage against heat-related failure
Holds its round shape better than thinner hoses when hot and under foot traffic
limitations: Stiffer than Flexzilla when cold, which matters on cooler desert mornings
Green color only, absorbs more heat than lighter shades
